title: External event marker
description: A client- or stimulus-authored event pushed into an active session's timeline, distinct from device-derived events.

id.description: Unique identifier for this marker event

sessionId.description: Identifier of the session this marker belongs to

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the marker occurred

label.description: Short identifier for the marker type, e.g. 'stimulus_onset', 'user_response', 'trial_start'

value.description: Optional descriptive payload associated with the marker (e.g. stimulus ID, response code)

source_clock.description: Origin of the marker timestamp, e.g. 'experimenter', 'stimulus-software', 'external-trigger'
